topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 105 project-authored contract(s) across 7 chain(s); 6 ERC4626 vaults, 12 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 41 common project-authored base contract(s) (constants, strategyfactory, multieth). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
